findings.title: BulkChannelMessageSendJob rescue block does not check :subject validation errors
findings.spec_requirement: Subject validated by CustomChannelMessageValidator on ChannelMessage model
findings.evidence: BulkChannelMessageSendJob RecordInvalid rescue checks e.record.errors.messages[:message] and [:body] but never [:subject]. If subject contains unsubstituted {{...}} placeholders, create! raises RecordInvalid with an error on :subject. Neither branch matches, so broadcast_error_message is never called. The error is logged but the user gets no growl notification — the message silently fails for that candidate.
findings.recommendation: Add a check for :subject errors in the RecordInvalid rescue block, or generalize the error extraction to handle any attribute.

findings.title: duplicate_message_exists? only checks body, not subject
findings.evidence: BulkChannelMessageSendJob line 15: ChannelMessage.duplicate_message_exists?(channel.id, channel_message_params[:body]). Two sends with identical bodies but different subjects would be treated as duplicates. Defensible as anti-spam guard, spec doesn't mention it.
findings.recommendation: No action needed. Existing behavior, out of spec scope.
